role: author-side offline review; coordinator independent review pending
review_order: Independent internal read-only helper read truth, frozen task/rubric, public finals and PUBLIC_RESPONSE originals before author cost or score.

answers.basis: Exact positive plane gap, ordered direction, valid nearest corner pair, current native topology and support-plane proof match public evidence.
Updated SAT and current native mesh support strict overlap, common interior point and projection intervals.
Current evaluated vertices, projection gap, direction and original-face witnesses establish the global minimum.
Reread changed geometry, common interior point and all outward face-plane distances establish strict positive-volume overlap.
Plane gap sqrt(3)/64, ordered normal, valid surface pair, all triangle-pair distances and four boundary edges per mesh support the surface result and open-solid limitation.
Geometry, precision, units and open-solid limits are supported. The phrase 'three requests' is imprecise. Actual evidence is one observe requesting three fact fields, all unknown.
answers.wording_note: Conservative partial grade for the extra tool-request statement. Coordinator may assess the wording independently. Original final remains verbatim.

S.extra_work: Both native scripts reread current evaluated vertices/triangles. Public answers add support-plane or shared-interior reasoning from those data.

G.followup: Native supplied current mesh/topology, open boundaries and surface plane/distance/direction witnesses.

cost_and_quality_rule: Observe adoption, full completion and cost are separate observed outcomes. This one fixed sample does not establish causal overall superiority.
